reviews.title: Fix this— can’t even use your app for its purpose.
reviews.text:
For some reason, whenever I try to use the “Ad Unlock” option for my widgets, I get a message saying “Failed to load AD,” followed by the options to try again later or purchase iScreen Premium.

At first, I assumed this was just a temporary issue, but I’ve been trying again repeatedly over the past several days and it still doesn’t work. I’ve checked multiple times, but the same error keeps appearing every time.

Could you please look into this and fix the issue? It’s extremely frustrating to have a feature that is supposed to work through watching an ad be completely unusable.

reviews.title: racism
reviews.text:
1 Star.
The lack of inclusivity in this app is honestly embarrassing. The smaller chibi style barely offers any darker skin tones, making it feel like people with deeper complexions were an afterthought. On top of that, the limited Black hairstyles are frustrating. Some of the options resemble exaggerated, stereotypical styles that have historically been used to mock Black people rather than represent the diversity of natural Black hair. It’s disappointing to see such little effort put into authentic representation.

Character creators should let everyone feel seen, yet this app overwhelmingly caters to lighter skin tones and straight hair textures while offering very few thoughtful options for Black users. Representation isn’t just checking a box—it’s about creating respectful, varied, and authentic customization. Until iScreen seriously expands its skin tone range and improves its Black hairstyles, I can’t recommend this app

reviews.title: Untrustworthy and corrupt
reviews.text: I came across a video of this app showing cool themes and widgets, and I was relatively hooked until I got the app. Upon launching the app it immediately suggested me to go on a subscription to premium which I declined but this would make it pretty difficult to find a theme as majority of the themes were locked behind a paywall which is basically forcing me to get the subscription. So I tried the AD trial which would hopefully give me the theme for a while but when watching the ad from the start to finish it would not grant me access to the theme then I came across a sketchy ad that was all in Chinese and tried to make me agree to something from the ad without me understanding it, that was the last straw so I uninstalled it. iScreen is a cesspit of sketchy advertising with an unfair selection of themes to choose from, do not recommend just stick to regular wallpapers.

reviews.title: app does offer a lot more fred widgets than others
reviews.text: I have to say, after downloading and trying out many widget apps, iscreen offers by far more free widgets than the others. In exchange, yes, ads load (*at first) at almost every click (click on a widget to view it, 'X' out, que ad, etc) however , the devs and designers have to get paid. I can't expect to just be able to download countless free widgets without compensating them in some way. Plus, after you are on the app for some time, the ads tend to die down and don't load on every click anymore. Also, the ads that do load are mostly very very quick - some of them do have the three screens where you tap "skip ad" , then another screen loads, you tap "open app store", it loads the apps page in the app store, click X, ANOTHER page loads, finally click X and you are done --- except, they are quick - no 5 sec countdown on each page load, promise. And many ads are just one screen you just have to X out of. I've tried many other widget apps and none of them offer nearly as many free CUTE widgets like this app does. And half of the non free ones you can get watching a quick ad. by FAR my fav widget app for cute kawaii widgets!

reviews.title: Things you should know!
reviews.text:
First of all, I would rate the app much higher but it's too overrated and here's why: 


1.Ads

1 of 3-4 adds plays every time you open the app + almost every minute if you have the free version. 

2. Locked choices

Basically every single widget, wallpaper, or icon is for an ad or you need premium. 

3. Strange inconveniences 

On the app, you can select a clear background but if you have liquid glass, the background will become foggy or have a shiny ring around it. Also, sometimes my widgets gain purple badges on my home screen that advertise for premium.

4. Defies the main reason I got it

I mainly wanted this app for Its variety and its music widget specifically. The variety is taken away without premium and the music widget can't access any of my music because it only uses apple music.


Overall:

I'd likely rate it 2-3 stars but I'm likely not going to use it very often and don't recommend it if you don't want the subscription.
